stem.text: Bacterial ribosomes consist of two subunits and a total of three rRNA molecules per ribosome. An analysis of **all** the 70S ribosomes from a single cell of the bacterium *Escherichia coli* showed that there were:

items: 19 000 copies of each type of rRNA molecule.

stem.text: How many 70S ribosomes were there in the *E. coli* cell?
